what: NRMSE records (the experimental comparison metric of decisions 64 and 65)

provenance.label: numerical solution of the stated model; not experimental validation
provenance.solver: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference

definition.formula: NRMSE(%) = 100 sqrt((1/N) sum_i (F_model,i - F_exp,i)^2) / F_scale, F_scale = max_i F_exp,i over the compatible points of the set

present_state: 0 of 28 records have a value. The registers hold no compatible point set today (science design Section 1.3: the AGR-1 heating-test totals and time series are upper bounds, not point comparisons), so N = 0 and no NRMSE value is produced; none is formed by relaxing a rule. The record names every excluded row and its reason.
difference_from_the_web_specification: deviations.json of web-v3-spec Section 4.2 is replaced by this file (nrmse.json): science design Section 7.3 and metric-nrmse.md Section 7 define the NRMSE record, and the spec's delta_exp definition is superseded by decision 64.
